question: If P : Q = 2 : 7, then what is the value of (Q - P) : (Q + P)?
solution:
Calculation:

If P : Q = 2 : 7

Let P = 2k & Q = 7k

So, (Q - P) : (Q + P) = (7k – 2k) : (7k + 2k) = 5k : 9k = 5 : 9

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
